title: Fixed-triangle binary projection square
statement: For a supplied compatible Cartesian triangle j,b,q,p,i,s with b p=q i and IsPullback, the full native binary projection equation holds for every bounded constructible K and finite-Tor L.

proof.text: Obtain TriangleLaws for the positive coefficient level from compositionProjectionMate, eliminating n=0 using hn and transporting ordinaryTensor to fixedScalarTensorData. This supplies invertibility of alpha and the equality leftMap=rightMap on the supplied triangle.
Use binary_composition_realization for the projection-free source and target boundary equations, and binary_iteration_triangle_pasting for the iterated projection edge.

Reuse the proved private fixed_factor_projection_refl from the iteration-pasting module. Generalize the total composite to a map f with equality f = j ≫ q, and eliminate that equality in the entire realization-pasting statement. At reflexivity the pullback transport is the identity, so the factor-projection identity gives the realized total edge. Finally cancel the target conjugation in component. The identity-transport calculation is proved at arbitrary categories and functors before specialization.

Apply the raw triangle equation under realization. Paste the four boundary equations, cancel the final target isomorphism, and use faithfulness of the intrinsic constructible inclusion to reflect the square to the required binarySquareEquation. These categorical cancellations are proved by private helpers in the item module.

proof_origin.place: Composition coherence: explicit raw triangle realization and faithful reflection; proof completed by E4, 2026-10-28.

lean.statement:
theorem binary_square_on_triangle
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (S : SixFunctorFiniteOperations D C E n hn)
    {X V W Y B Z : SixFunctorSpace D}
    (j : X ⟶ V) (b : V ⟶ W) (q : V ⟶ Y) (p : W ⟶ B) (i : Y ⟶ B) (s : B ⟶ Z)
    [IsOpenImmersion ((geometry D).map j)] [IsOpenImmersion ((geometry D).map b)]
    [IsOpenImmersion ((geometry D).map i)] [QuasiCompact ((geometry D).map b)]
    [QuasiCompact ((geometry D).map i)]
    [IsProper ((geometry D).map q)] [IsProper ((geometry D).map p)] [IsProper ((geometry D).map s)]
    (hb : b ≫ p = q ≫ i)
    (sq : IsPullback b.hom.left q.hom.left p.hom.left i.hom.left)
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E n hn X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E n hn Z.obj.left) :
    binarySquareEquation S (X := X) (Y := Y) (Z := Z) (j ≫ q) (i ≫ s)
      (binaryFirst j q) (binarySecond i s)
      (binaryTotal j b q p i s hb) K L
